data.one_liner: Flutter WebView implementation that blocks ads and trackers using filter lists.
data.what_it_does: Provides a WebView widget for Flutter with built-in ad and tracker blocking capabilities based on EasyList and AdGuard filter lists. Supports both URL and HTML content loading, navigation control, custom JavaScript injection, whitelisting, and statistics tracking.
use_when: You need to display web content inside your Flutter application while blocking ads and trackers.
You require domain-based filtering, custom user agents, and element hiding in a WebView.
You want to track blocking statistics and manage whitelisted domains.
avoid_when: You require a general-purpose webview without adblocking overhead.
You need advanced desktop browser features not supported by the underlying mobile-focused webview plugins.
strengths: Supports EasyList and AdGuard filter lists for robust ad blocking.
Provides singleton controller for dynamic domain whitelisting and statistics.
Early resource blocking for better performance.
weaknesses: Relies on official Flutter WebView plugin which may have platform-specific limitations.
Requires specific minimum Flutter and Dart versions.
data.setup_notes: Initialize the singleton controller with a FilterConfig in main() before running the app.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a standard official WebView without built-in ad blocking capabilities.

data.minimal_example:
AdBlockerWebview(
  url: Uri.parse('https://example.com'),
  shouldBlockAds: true,
  adBlockerWebviewController: AdBlockerWebviewController.instance,
)
